name: Righteous Fire Chieftain
summary: Righteous Fire on the Chieftain shell: a tanky fire aura that burns enemies while you walk, backed by armour, life regeneration and fire resistance. Fire Trap levels the character, then Righteous Fire comes online at red maps with Purity of Fire, Vitality and Enduring Cry making the self-burn net positive. Malevolence and Flammability carry the damage; the legal jewel caps keep the single-target and clear numbers modest, but the build is cheap, forgiving and has no required unique.

notes: First guide for the Covens league.
The measured build now passes the standard gate profile at every checkpoint, not only the Dad floors.
Fire Trap levels the campaign and white maps; Righteous Fire comes online at red maps with capped resistance, Purity of Fire, level-14 Vitality and three Enduring Cry charges.
The endgame link uses Lifetap, Swift Affliction, Burning Damage, Elemental Focus and Concentrated Effect; Controlled Destruction and Increased Area of Effect were dropped.
The shared jewel-affix correction replaced illegal weapon-scale rolls; the build measures 212.0k RF DPS at pinnacle and 122.1k at red maps, ratings 9/7/7/9 (S).
Sustain was re-measured: net life regeneration is positive at red maps and pinnacle, and the build needs no unique or Awakened gem.
The 28-38 step shows the four-link and the gems that unlock at 38; the fifth link waits for 68 and the sixth for red maps.

summary.text: Righteous Fire Chieftain is a low-APM fire aura build that levels with Rolling Magma, then Fire Trap, and switches to Righteous Fire at red maps. It measures 122.1k DPS at red maps and 212.0k DPS at pinnacle. Purity of Fire, Vitality, three Enduring Cry charges and the boots' life-regeneration implicit keep the self-burn net positive; Enduring Cry's regeneration adds margin while the warcry buff is up. Malevolence and Flammability carry the bossing damage, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Rolling Magma into Fire Trap; the first checkpoint measures 445 life and 29 DPS, and the second measures 428 DPS with Fire Trap. Fire Trap carries the campaign and white maps; stay on it until the red-map set is complete: the six-link, capped fire resistance, three Enduring Cry charges, and the boots life-regeneration and helmet reservation-efficiency implicits. The leveling panel opens the Righteous Fire bracket before that set; do not switch until it is complete. Without the charges the burn is net negative; with them, Purity of Fire and Vitality make the degen sustainable, and Enduring Cry's regeneration adds margin while the warcry buff is up.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 122.1k DPS with 26.3k effective life and 11.1k physical max hit. Those physical numbers assume three Enduring Cry charges and the listed flasks; the Amethyst Flask is what keeps chaos resistance positive here, and the measured pinnacle cap still uses it. Concentrated Effect is the default link; swap it for Increased Area of Effect when you want a wider aura, at the cost of the Concentrated Effect damage. Purity of Fire, Vitality, three Enduring Cry charges and the boots' life-regeneration Eldritch implicit keep the self-burn net positive, but the margin is thin. Enduring Cry's regeneration adds margin while the warcry buff is up, so recast it on cooldown; the charges are also the physical layer, so do not let them drop. The helmet's reservation efficiency implicit is part of the measured aura fit. Lifetap pays for Flame Dash, Flammability and the warcry; in the RF link it converts the cost to life, and its more-damage buff is not part of the measured number. The low mana bar does not stop the loop. The measured clear number is modest; the aura and Hinekora do the work. Keep Enduring Cry and Flammability up and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 212.0k DPS with 42.0k effective life, 13.4k physical max hit and 75% chaos resistance. Stand in the aura, keep Flammability on the boss, and move for the slams and the mechanics that would kill you; use the stationary windows only when the fight lets you. The measured damage does not include Ramako's stationary effect, which can override Flammability's fire-resistance curse rather than add to it, so do not count it as extra damage. The measured self-burn is net positive with Purity of Fire, Vitality, three Enduring Cry charges and the boots' life-regeneration Eldritch implicit, but the margin is thin. Enduring Cry's regeneration adds margin while the warcry buff is up; the charges are also the physical layer, so do not let them drop. The physical and self-burn numbers assume three charges (the config override; a lone rare enemy supplies two) and the listed flasks; the aura fit assumes the helmet's reservation efficiency implicit. The measured damage does not include the Lifetap buff. The Amethyst Flask is part of the measured chaos resistance at red maps and the chaos cap at pinnacle; do not drop it for a damage flask unless the gear adds the missing chaos resistance. The measured single-target number is below the dedicated boss builds.
